title: replay — input
description: Input schema for the SOX replay operation. Returns historical messages from a channel using a per-channel seq cursor. Access is gated by the channel's replay_policy (subscriber | admin_only | custom); the default is 'subscriber', meaning the same auth chain as recv applies. Normative reference: spec/primitives/channels.md (replay_policy), spec/primitives/sequence-numbers.md, docs/decisions/replay-access-control.md.

channel.description: The channel to replay from. The calling agent must satisfy the channel's replay_policy.

since.description: Return messages with seq > since. Use 0 to replay from the beginning of the channel. Use the seq of the last message seen to replay only missed messages. This is the per-channel cursor — it refers only to seq values on the specified channel.

until.description: Return messages with seq <= until. When null, replay continues to the current head of the channel. Combined with 'since', defines the inclusive range (since, until].

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return in a single replay call. When the range contains more messages than limit, has_more=true and the caller should paginate using the seq of the last returned message as the next 'since'.
